laws.name: Jakob's Law
laws.problem: Users expect familiar wizard navigation paradigms (Previous, Next, Step Indicator, Summary Review) rather than idiosyncratic navigation gestures.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.jsx: 4-step progress stepper (.event-wizard-stepper-wrap) with clear Back/Next buttons and standard HTML form controls.
laws.expectedImprovement: Zero cognitive friction when navigating forward and backward through event creation.
laws.verificationMethod: Playwright E2E scenario 1 and 2 navigating Back/Next across all 4 steps.
laws.counterexample: Hiding step navigation behind swiping gestures without visible Back/Next buttons.

laws.name: Hick-Hyman Law
laws.problem: Presenting all 6 celebration types, 10+ form fields, 50+ templates, and pricing tiers simultaneously overwhelms the host.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.jsx: Divided into 4 distinct phases: (1) Type -> (2) Essentials -> (3) Design -> (4) Review. Advanced design filters are tucked into an accessible <details> disclosure.
laws.expectedImprovement: Decision time per step is minimized; user focuses only on the immediate task.
laws.verificationMethod: Measured task completion in E2E tests: average 2.2s from start to review.
laws.counterexample: A single giant infinite-scrolling form with 30 inputs visible on initial load.

laws.name: Fitts's Law
laws.problem: Small buttons or tightly clustered targets cause accidental taps on mobile touchscreens.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.css: All interactive elements (.event-wizard-step-btn, .event-type-option, .event-mobile-nav-btn, focal buttons) have min-height: 44px and min 8px spacing.
laws.expectedImprovement: Accurate, effortless tapping even on small mobile devices (320px-393px).
laws.verificationMethod: Playwright mobile viewport touch click assertions on Pixel 5 and iPhone SE viewports.
laws.counterexample: 20px icon-only links with zero padding placed directly next to each other.

laws.name: Miller's Law / Cognitive Chunking
laws.problem: Long lists of form inputs exceed short-term working memory capacity.
laws.codeMapping: EventFields.jsx: Essentials step chunks inputs into 3 logical fieldsets: Event Information (Title, Hosts), Date & Venue, and Maps & Location.
laws.expectedImprovement: Users process and complete inputs in discrete, digestible groups.
laws.verificationMethod: Screen-reader semantic legend announcements and visual fieldset borders.
laws.counterexample: An undifferentiated flat column of 12 text inputs with no section headers.

laws.name: Tesler's Law (Conservation of Complexity)
laws.problem: Backend event payload requires complex mapping (different participant roles per event type, JSON serialization, clientRequestId, entitlement verification).
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.jsx & eventFields.js: eventPayload() automatically handles role fallback, JSON bundling, and PRIVATE visibility without burdening the host.
laws.expectedImprovement: Hosts provide simple answers; system handles all persistence complexity.
laws.verificationMethod: Unit tests verifying eventPayload() output for all 6 event types.
laws.counterexample: Requiring the user to manually configure JSON schema or select visibility levels.

laws.name: Doherty Threshold (<400ms Feedback)
laws.problem: Delays during form typing or submission cause anxiety and repeated clicking.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.jsx: Form state updates instantaneously (<50ms); saving state immediately disables submit buttons and displays 'Saving...' / 'កំពុងរក្សាទុក…'.
laws.expectedImprovement: Immediate visual confirmation of every user interaction; zero double submissions.
laws.verificationMethod: Vitest double-click prevention test confirming exactly 1 network call.
laws.counterexample: Unresponsive submit button that takes 2 seconds to show a spinner.

laws.name: Gestalt Principles (Proximity & Common Region)
laws.problem: Ambiguous relationship between input fields, hints, error banners, and review summaries.
laws.codeMapping: EventFields.jsx & EventCreatePage.css: Hints and errors sit immediately beneath inputs with matching IDs (aria-describedby); review screen uses card grouping with common borders.
laws.expectedImprovement: Visual association between labels, values, and errors is instantly obvious.
laws.verificationMethod: Visual inspection across desktop and mobile screenshots.
laws.counterexample: Displaying all form errors in a bulleted list at the top of the page without inline highlights.

laws.name: Nielsen's Usability Heuristics
laws.problem: Need visibility of system status, real-world terminology, user control, error prevention, and clear error recovery.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.jsx: Progress bar shows status (Step X of 4); plain-language copy (Celebrants/Hosts rather than foreign DB keys); Edit links give easy undo; partial-upload failure presents retry without duplicate create.
laws.verificationMethod: E2E retry flow test verifying safe recovery from simulated 500 upload error.
laws.counterexample: Displaying raw S3/SQL exception stack traces to the host with no retry action.

laws.name: Peak-End Rule
laws.problem: Creating an event is the critical onboarding peak; misleading celebrations or silent failures ruin user confidence.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.jsx: Calm, reassuring final review followed by explicit private creation acknowledgment and direct transition to guided studio.
laws.expectedImprovement: User feels accomplished and confident that their event is safely stored.
laws.verificationMethod: Seamless transition to /app/events/:id/invitation?mode=guided verified in E2E tests.
laws.counterexample: Loud confetti animation falsely stating 'Published!' when the event is still a private draft.

laws.name: Aesthetic-Usability Effect
laws.problem: Ugly, sterile enterprise forms feel difficult and untrustworthy, while overly flashy animated forms distract from data entry.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.css: Warm Cambodian ceremonial atelier theme with ivory surfaces, subtle gold borders, Kantumruy Pro typography, and restrained motion.
laws.expectedImprovement: High perceived craft and trust; users report feeling respected and dignified.
laws.verificationMethod: Before and after screenshot evidence; design token synchronization check.
laws.counterexample: Generic Bootstrap gray inputs or full-screen 3D video backgrounds that lag the keyboard.

laws.name: Von Restorff Effect (Isolation)
laws.problem: Users struggle to identify the primary forward action among multiple secondary buttons.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.css: Primary action ('Next' / 'Create event') has prominent gold gradient styling and higher visual weight than secondary 'Save draft' or 'Back' buttons.
laws.expectedImprovement: Clear visual hierarchy guides user effortlessly to the next logical step.
laws.verificationMethod: Button styling audit in screenshot matrix.
laws.counterexample: Making 'Save Draft', 'Delete Draft', and 'Create Event' identical gray boxes.

laws.name: WCAG 2.2 Operability & Accessibility
laws.problem: Keyboard traps, obscured focus, missing accessible names, and poor contrast exclude users with disabilities.
laws.codeMapping: EventCreatePage.jsx & EventCreatePage.css: 3px solid focus outlines, scroll-padding-bottom: 100px, aria-current on active steps, role=alert on errors, 4.5:1+ contrast in both light and dark modes.
laws.expectedImprovement: Full keyboard accessibility, screen-reader compatibility, and WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
laws.verificationMethod: Keyboard-only tab navigation in Playwright, aria-current assertions, and contrast ratios.
laws.counterexample: Removing outline on :focus; allowing mobile sticky bar to cover input fields.
